notes.title: January 2022 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the January 2022 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month, we'll go over fences, outdoor decor, and meet the C.I.C!


Alpha v0.07 will launch on March 7 @ 11:59PM PDT.


Happy New Year (again!)

Happy lunar new year to those who celebrate!


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_f3e713cba4804ea7a6822de320f10d59~mv2.jpg

Fences, Gates & Arches

Take a look at how fences, gates, and arches will work in the game!


Fences

Placing fences is super easy. Select the fence item on your hotbar, find an empty spot on your farmland and plot it down.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_43143ab2ce6a4b088a739d1a7225a727~mv2.png

There are three different styles for how fences connect. We have the following from left to right: post on every tile fence, homogenous fence, and corner post fence.


Gates

Now that you've fenced an area, we need a way to get in and out. To place gates, find an empty spot between two fences, and place it. Voila, you now have a gate!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_97f4a0379316496e99fae932d884f178~mv2.gif

Good news, all styles of gates will work with any fence style. 


Arches

Complete your decoration with arches! You'll be able to rotate them in 4 directions and place them anywhere on the tillable ground.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_597f426f91e14fe38277d9c3cc9fb67c~mv2.png

We're still developing the feature, but you'll be able to place half arches and make double-wide ones too. For a sneak peek of this, be sure to join our Discord here.


Community vote: add fence vaulting, or not

Last but not least, we're looking for feedback from the community. Do you want us to explore fence vaulting for the game? Please let us know your thoughts!


Outdoor Decor

We've been hard at work adding a variety of styles for your outdoor decoration needs.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_351604c23b614fe688d5e1c6c392d10d~mv2.png

Here's a sneak peek at the Mountain Cabin Outdoor Props. Let us know what other styles you want to see in the game!


Meet the C.I.C (Coral Island Current)

The Coral Island current is an underwater highway transporting various things to and from different parts of the ocean. It's located on the West side of the island.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_960c215ba6c44a74b979173b516f48d5~mv2.gif

[where's all the fish...?]


Fanart Contest: Valentines in Coral Island

Win a chance for your character's hair design to be featured in the game!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_7c3ba95b4c954a59ab9926f79ccac2b2~mv2.jpg


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_1a928700dc7a4375a8e36f26754d9295~mv2.jpg


What's next?

For Alpha v0.07, we've got the following planned: 

- Renovated museum
- Heritage implemented (temple offerings)
- More interiors and exteriors
- Refreshed 10m diving maps
- Rebalanced mastery progressions
- And more!


Thanks for reading,

Stairway Team

notes.title: December 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the December 2021 Coral Island development update!

Please check out our Steam page to wishlist the game and find out more: swg.gg/corstm


This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.06. Take a look at Giants gameplay and how Town Rank will work in the game. 


Alpha v0.06 will launch on January 10 @ 11:59PM PDT.


Happy Holidays

Happy holidays from everyone at Stairway! Here's to a great 2022.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_97b81d5ef32b40138bd73a597079beac~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_1106,al_c,q_90/491ae5_97b81d5ef32b40138bd73a597079beac~mv2.webp

HD Wallpaper for Backers

We'll be sending HD/4k versions of this wallpaper early next year, and it will come in both horizontal and vertical orientations. Thank you to all backers. We hope you like it!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_4cada23810f9459381ecbb516d30f408~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90/491ae5_4cada23810f9459381ecbb516d30f408~mv2.webp
[what's the first thing you noticed?]

Giants Gameplay Prototype

At long last, we're ready to talk about Giants! 


Giants are farm helpers that you'll unlock as you progress through the game. By deciding which totems to craft and where to place them, you have ultimate control over the type of help you get on your farm.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_548ae7a6e9e44e808a5db4ec89c0a81d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2992,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_548ae7a6e9e44e808a5db4ec89c0a81d~mv2.webp

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_92e9cfad7cbb4f219f4ca5ee9fb4e09e~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2994,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_92e9cfad7cbb4f219f4ca5ee9fb4e09e~mv2.webp

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_596e6a4309db486ba916c36f3d725f9d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2991,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_596e6a4309db486ba916c36f3d725f9d~mv2.webp

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_2991,h_1683,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.webp
[craft and place totems to get some help on your farm!]

There are three types of craftable totems: water, harvest, and animal totems. Today we're going to take a look at the Water and Harvest totem.


Water Totem

Place Water Totems to get help watering tilled soil. Please note, Alpha players that the Water Totem will replace any previously placed Sprinklers on your farm.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dc3661319e5b4aa1bc25a07fb49931b8~mv2.webp

Now, for a look at the water totem in action:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_400eee65981145b883fc87f9622236f6~mv2.gif

 [Totems activate when a Giant is about to work its coverage area]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2c260ae3ac91408fa0aa030ade325b54~mv2.gif

[who doesn't get happy when their work is done for the day]

Gather Totem

Place Gather Totems to get help gather items on your farm. They come in handy to harvest crops and collect items from processing and artisan equipment.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_bf059f9c344146288789910a062436d3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_bf059f9c344146288789910a062436d3~mv2.webp

Now, for a look at the Gather Totem in action:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_14a6997bc1d5468c8b2db4c1836ee6a4~mv2.gif

[REDACTED is skilled at Gathering]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6593887fd3aa4143ba99b50b02ff8a11~mv2.gif
[It's not all work and no play for the Giants. Or err... nap time]

Collecting Gathered Items

The Giants will place gathered items inside a plant pouch, and it's conveniently located to the left of your house. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_54eaef0dc4a048da85d630d22b62aec9~mv2.gif

[worth checking the plant pouch now and then...]


The Three Giants

Although each Giant can work on all farm tasks, they excel at one thing. To unleash the full potential of a particular farm task, you'll need to unlock higher grade totems and develop your relationship with the Giants.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_93fa5bcdc29248e99e2d2a5aa9b12647~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_816,h_622,al_c,lg_1,q_95/491ae5_93fa5bcdc29248e99e2d2a5aa9b12647~mv2.webp

Town Rank

The residents of Coral Island want to improve the town, for good reason! 

The town rank comprises four key components: Heritage, Fame, Museum, and Ocean. We've added a special tab in the UI to keep tabs on your progress and figure out ways to earn points. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_dd1369aeb8814d748d62c08f4fb08bea~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_dd1369aeb8814d748d62c08f4fb08bea~mv2.webp
[WIP of Town Rank UI]

As you increase the town's rank, shops will have an easier time sourcing items, which means new things for you to buy. And well, who knows what other shops you'll attract to town.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ac01a4ed4bc947d5a8f286325e4cbb6d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_ac01a4ed4bc947d5a8f286325e4cbb6d~mv2.webp[mock up of store selling new items after town rank increases]

The town hall houses a monitor that tracks your progress toward increasing the town rank.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d8648ba8e16a48a18a8935c5b16ca162~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_95/491ae5_d8648ba8e16a48a18a8935c5b16ca162~mv2.webp
[that's one big monitor]


Other updates

For 0.06:

- Q&A system with NPC testable with Yuri, more information available in Discord
- Several map tweaks have been made
- Opened up the blocked path on Hillside
- Functioning gates for fences
- New buildings on the map?
- Manual cooking!
- Cherry Blossom main festival objective implemented
- New interior music, check it out
- Various bug fixes and optimizations

What's next?

For Alpha v0.07, we've got the following planned: 

- Renovated museum
- Heritage implemented (temple offerings)
- More interiors and exteriors
- Refreshed 10m diving maps
- Rebalanced mastery progressions
- And more!

Changes for 2022:

- We're increasing the time between Alpha updates from 1 month to 2 months. For example, Alpha 0.07 will launch in March 2022
- We will continue posting dev updates every month




Thanks for reading,

Stairway Team

notes.title: November 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the November 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.05. 

Alpha v0.05 will launch on November 30 @ 11:59PM PDT.


We're Grateful

Everyone at Stairway has a lot to be thankful for this year. Happy Thanksgiving, everyone!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0c980d5782d24012a48c195d927a48c9~mv2.jpg


Cherry Blossom Festival

We've completed most of the assets for the Cherry Blossom festival. To avoid spoilers, we'll only be showing the entrance and lake area:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_939a15b9c96b42ac9aadfd62ded51803~mv2.png

Below, the decorated lake and a sneak peek at the Cherry Blossom festival music!

[previewyoutube=b7NhNts_Dt0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



Festival Day Decoration

Themed umbul-umbul (penjor) are displayed around Coral Island on festival day. The goal is twofold: communicate that it's festival day and help guide players to the festival area.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1184450aab7644908ebb4e06c662effd~mv2.jpg

Umbul-umbuls will be decorated differently based on what festival is being held:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_89a5d429fabb476599b15dbc28934542~mv2.jpg

[hmm, mooncake!]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d5594e398a2e406b865bc920b5118323~mv2.gif

[an early in-game look what the umbul-umbul will look like]


Fast Travel

Oh, the places you'll go! 

Introducing the fast travel system. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock tokens that can be used to activate teleport spots around the map. Here is a look at it in action:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_99860f5623624abfae8f243f968fd584~mv2.gif

[alpha players, please note that fast travel will be limited to 5 areas for now]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3aec635ceac141debcbee01998223cb2~mv2.gif

[whoooooosh]


Farm Building Upgrade

More room for farm friends! Alpha players will now be able to upgrade both the coop and barn building. There is a total of one upgrade for each building, giving you a maximum capacity of 8 animals per building.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0aa8875daa4044fd837e51c4918baf36~mv2.gif

[the upgrade flow]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_324d2474ec784776b51ae6ceb3f2aaca~mv2.png

[one can never have too many chikins]


Revamped Buildings

This month, we're showing off the interiors for the clinic and school. As for exteriors, we'll be showcasing what the townies call the dump.


Exteriors

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0be89a8276754c6ab51b7f36aa272caf~mv2.png

[no comment]

Interiors

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8991f9f3fc334b1a895d7736efe1d975~mv2.png

[the clinic]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7f05d57ddfd941fda7af724d303ebaba~mv2.png

[the school]


Revamped Grass and Mines

Progress continues to be made in the mines, and grass. Yes, we finally have grass!

New Environtment Grass

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_454c72a570ec49c1a7a1987e3b3705e3~mv2.png

[we're still in the process of applying grass across the map]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_2125f902031e4be9ae752b56dc60f449~mv2.gif

[a close up of the new grass]

Mine Earth Theme

A lot of progress was made on the mines this month. An additional 15 levels have been redecorated with improved assets!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fd0aeae5ab884738a22ffcf280c9b206~mv2.png

[mineeeees!]


Edited Dialogues

More edited dialogues, for this month!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_12d22439edfe43e19961a10f8e1e81cb~mv2.png


Other Updates & Behind the Scene

- The Q&A system with NPC's has been delayed to next month
- Woodlands is now open to Alpha players
- 'Grass' now drops from scything grass. The mill is required to process `grass` into `fodder`. Fodder can now be dispensed inside coop and barn provided player has a Mill.
- Added music for buildings, including Carpenter, General Store, and more!
- Basic town rank implemented. For now, you can earn points by donating to the museum, planting super coral, and completing sesajen offerings at the temple. As town rank increases, merchants will have more items to sell


What's next?

Next month, for Alpha v0.06, we've got the following planned: 

- Giants gameplay
- Town rank fully implemented
- Q&A system with NPC
- HD Wallpaper for backers revealed and delivered
- And more!

Thanks for reading, 
Stairway Team

notes.title: October 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the October 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.04. 

Alpha v0.04 will launch on October 31 @ 11:59PM PDT.


Happy Halloween!

Spooky, but then make it *Coral Island*.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f7be4d9aea024b81bb14ade6cd259c32~mv2.jpg


Bug catching

Get your Bug net ready! We're releasing an early WIP bug-catching system! Eventually, you will donate bugs and unlock an area for them at the Museum (not ready for Alpha). In the meantime, purchase a bug net at the Beach Shack, and start catching!

P.S. the bug models are placeholder and not final.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_85fc67258b98440382d2fe8554406e91~mv2.gif

[There are different types of bugs depending on the time of day, location, and seasons.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b27b4ded3b2c4464be024ed3415d550c~mv2.gif

[Not a-sneaking-type of farmer? Don't worry. Find slow bugs. Shown above: caterpillar. Adorable and slow.]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9abbe22a4400423bb4b88597f59886a4~mv2.gif

[Careful though! Some bugs are very fast and perceptive of human movement. Sneaking might just be necessary to catch them.]

Thank you to all the backers that made bug-catching a reality in Coral Island. This is one of the first stretch goals we unlocked on Kickstarter.


Player house upgrade

You can now upgrade the house! In the first house upgrade, you will receive a kitchen that allows you to cook various dishes. Pay a visit to the Carpenters and they'll be able to help you with upgrading the house. Make sure to bring enough money!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_52da0c329d0c4a6e9a95c5e393489331~mv2.png

[the exterior of the first house upgrade]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d20b8f6d4791475c9b3e466e44ebc821~mv2.png

[look at all that space, plus a built-in kitchen!]


Coral Shopping

Have too much money and don't know where to spend it? Worry not. Introducing Coral Shopping! Here you'll find items to complete your Kitchen. Check out the channel on your TV to find out what's for sale. Then, head to Socket & Pan to make a purchase. New items are available for purchase every Tuesday!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_19fec7854359400bafc703b26ecc07b2~mv2.gif

[a look at what the shopping flow looks like... purchased items are installed in your kitchen. Anyone else feel a little nostalgic?]


Cooking part 1

In Coral Island, there are two ways to cook. By recipes and manual. You can simply click on any learned recipe on the recipe tab or do it the old-fashioned way, mix and match. High risk, high return, right?

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_16f6b740f8464d3583bfc67554d062c3~mv2.gif

[there are around 10 utensils to collect... I spy, with my little eye, a Blender, Grill...what else?]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f87f3f1bee2d42129e676281a08e541e~mv2.png

[recipes tab are the easiest way to cook things you've already cooked before]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_eabac3dcfc4446adb7b8116e9cbc7355~mv2.png

[the manual tab is for the adventurous; mix and match utensils and ingredients and unlock recipes yourself through trial and error. PS, please don't mind the placeholder art above]

Please note Alpha players, only the recipe section is available in the 0.04 update.


Revamped Buildings

This month, we're showcasing Socket & Pan, Salon, Community Center, and Jim's house. Keep in mind that Salon's, animal shelter's and clothing store's features are NOT ready for Alpha...that said, don't let it stop you from exploring the interiors. There might be interesting notes in there.


Exteriors

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3695a9920cb2474baab5d175faa503f3~mv2.png

[Socket & Pan]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d4ed6fcc696143cabff4a8bbdcde521a~mv2.png

[Jim's House. This is where Jim, Lily and Theo live.]


Interiors

The animal shelter is where you'll go to adopt a pet. For all the Kickstarter backers with the Pet Design tier, this is where you can meet your pet! Also worth noting, the Community Center is one of the largest interiors we've worked on to date.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3f50916debcd4d74a8d38fa56bb34e65~mv2.png

[The Community Center has 5 rooms inside it: Yoga room, White Flamingo clothing store, town hall, library, and an animal shelter. We're not going to show more due to SPOILERS]


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_b851f33b0636409fadf453d33e593312~mv2.png

[Salon is run by Emily and Erika. One word = chic.]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_01223977c0c04e1cb69fa04844e7d636~mv2.png

[Socket & Pan. Submit your TV shopping orders here!]


Cutscenes & dialogue

More edited dialogues, more cutscenes, more fun!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_a8c1840d77ab4e1fa5dbe9c3827a716a~mv2.png


Other updates

- Added a WIP Town Rank system, check it out in the community center
- Experimenting with additional simplified daytime music
- Experimenting with cloud shadows in the game
- Display player objective in the Diving UI level selector
- Completed exteriors not listed: Mansion and Clinic
- Unlocked the Look Out area, now accessible to Alpha players
- Added a WIP glossary section to the main UI


What's next?

Next month, for Alpha v0.05, we've got a lot planned: 

- Open up the Woodlands area to Alpha players
- Unlock farm building upgrades (for barn and coop) and the Greenhouse
- First version of the Town Rank system that ties the game together
- New Q&A dialogue system with NPC's (unlock questions/topics to discuss with an NPC as you get closer with them)
- More revamped buildings (exteriors and interiors)
- And much more!



Thanks for reading, 
Stairway Team

notes.title: September 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the September 2021 Coral Island development update!

This month, we'll go over the highlights of Alpha v0.03 and provide an update on Coral Island's release.

Ranching part 2 (mooo)

Ranching sees a big update this month. We release the barn, which allows you to purchase your first Barn animal, baby & adult cow. You'll buy the Barn from the carpenter and the cow itself from the Ranch. While at the Ranch, be sure to purchase a Milk Pail so you can get to milking!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_6f4000262ec04f4ea6897665b785f9dc~mv2.gif
[baby & adult cow, just mooing around the barn]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_44ca51502c574668b586cc1649ec44cc~mv2.gif
[over time, baby cows turn into adult cows]

Move or sell farm animals

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5c5b0a995aed43f784ba0c58a8625eee~mv2.gif
[please excuse the programmer UI art for the move and sell buttons, lol]

Fishing Gameplay

For all of you fishers out there, your time has finally arrived. You can finally fish in the game! Currently, there are only about 10 fish you can catch. Where you find them depends on where you'll fish: in the ocean, river, or lake.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_63aa3d1f53ae4bf88e2d6cd2f934bf6d~mv2.png
[purchase a fishing pole at the Beach Shack]

Please be mindful! Cast length in our game impacts the size of fish you are likely to catch. For example, a shorter cast has a higher chance of catching a small fish like the goldfish.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3c66e1469f7548c7bd640457d36150e0~mv2.gif
[how long you hold the cast button will determine the cast length]

Map 2.0 (featuring player tracking!)

Player tracking on the map was one of the most requested features we received after launching Alpha. With the new map, you'll be able to do just that!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_eb89b7912fb94a68a6b7dc197fd09dea~mv2.png
[check it out, that's you, Player!]

We're working to tie the map tracking experience with the social mastery component of the game. By acquiring the appropriate skill and heart level with an NPC, you'll be able to see an icon of them on the map.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_108428cc83f54a62965cf94fe748f024~mv2.png
[we are still playing around with the NPC icons for the tracking feature]

Revamped exteriors

Alpha v0.02 will launch on August 31 @ 8 PM PDT.

Over 20,000 players participated in the Alpha v0.01 of the game. Thank you so much for providing feedback on the game, sharing your impressions, and of course, finding and submitting those pesky bugs.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c08f499003004074ac72f56cef34a172~mv2.png

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_e340f7f2eb3f4c26a719101ed3cc7d89~mv2.gif

notes.title: Coral Island Alpha Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Farmers,

Gear up and get ready to explore Coral Island. The Alpha playtest is coming soon!

About the Alpha

What is Alpha?

The Alpha is an early version of the game available for testing purposes only. The game is NOT ready for public release yet and may contain bugs, errors, and defects. Some of the issues that we can think of are, the save file might get corrupted, and you might have to restart and play the game from the very beginning multiple times. Please keep in mind that the game is still in development.


So bugs, huh? Then why release the Alpha?

The main objective of this Alpha is to playtest the game, and gather feedback to help improve the game. We need your help on this. Feedback, bug reports, suggestions, anything that we can use to improve Coral Island.


How do I report bugs?

There will be two ways for you to report bugs:

Submit the report in-game, by pressing Escape menu → click Feedback
Sending it to our bug report Discord channel. (Alpha Channels → #alpha-bug-report)


Who can play the Alpha?

Alpha playtest is only available for Alpha Farmer Pack ($30) backers and above, as well as some selected registrants in our previous Discord giveaway.

If you backed under $30 and want to play Alpha, please visit our Backerkit store to pre-order! (PC/Steam only)


When will the Alpha keys be sent?

Alpha Steam keys will be sent in batches on the day the Alpha starts, to be exact, on July 31st, 6 PM PDT / August 1st, 8 AM GMT+7.

The process might take time due to the high number of players, so please wait for at least 12 hours. If you still haven’t received your key by then, email us at contact@stairwaygames.com.


Where will the Alpha keys be sent?

The keys will be sent to the email address that is linked to your order. The sender’s address will be no-reply@s.backerkit.com with the email title as “New Digital Content for Coral Island”.

Additionally, you can log in to Backerkit with your Kickstarter account, click on Coral Island, and click on Digital Downloads to view your Steam key code.


How do I use the Alpha keys?

You can activate the Steam key to add Coral Island to your Steam library. From there, you can install the game and start playing.

Additional information that might be helpful: A guide on How to Activate a Product on Steam.

Self-promo! Don’t forget to Wishlist us on Steam too, if you haven’t done so!


How long will the Alpha be?

Alpha will start on July 31st at 6 PM PDT / August 1 at 8 AM GMT+7 and last until around Q4 2021. For the exact date, please wait for our future updates.


About Non-Disclosure Agreement

Before playing the Alpha, please keep in mind that this Alpha playtest will be under Non-Disclosure Agreement. (You can opt-out of the NDA by NOT installing or playing the Alpha.)


What does it mean?

Simple! Under the NDA, you agree not to share, publish, disclose, distribute, transmit, post, or make available, directly or indirectly,  Confidential Information about Coral Island Alpha playtest to any third party or public audience until we publicly release the product or content. Confidential Information includes screenshots of the game, video of gameplay from the game, or any other form of information sharing, such as discussing the game or allowing others to watch you play the game or leave the game running unattended. However, you may disclose the existence of the Alpha and that you are a member of the Alpha playtest.


In the case of Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) breach by sharing Alpha content with non-Alpha players, we reserve the right to all actions available to us under the law, such as revoking your Alpha Access key(s), denying your access to the game, and possible legal action.

If you see someone breaking the NDA, kindly contact us at contact@stairwaygames.com with proof of a violation and we will investigate it. We really appreciate your cooperation!

Although you cannot share the initial Alpha release, rest assured you'll be able to stream later at some point during Alpha, closer to Early Access. We will keep you updated with the confirmed time after implementing Alpha feedback to the game.


Other Information
Please note that the rewards below will be available upon the official 1.0 release in 2022.

- Character & Pet Design, Mythical Pet, Premium Clothing, Coral Crown
- Hi-Res Digital Wallpaper Pack, Digital Artbook & OST
- Founder Statue & Name in Credit
 
Early Access key will be available when it starts around Q4 2021. We will announce the details closer to Early Access!

If you have more questions, kindly direct them to contact@stairwaygames.com, or ask away in our Discord channel.


Pack up, Farmers! We’re going to Coral Island soon!

notes.title: June 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the June 2021 Coral Island development update!

For this month’s developer update, we will share more details of the upcoming Alpha.

Alpha Content

To start, we want to be transparent and share with you all that Alpha content for 0.01 will be a bit different from what we originally planned. We are a bit behind in some areas and ahead in others. The worsening pandemic in Indonesia has made it an incredibly challenging time for production. In the past month, several of our team members became infected with Covid; as of this update, a couple more are out sick because of it.


It’s not all bad news, though. Despite all this, Alpha will still release as scheduled on July 31st. Below you will find a revised breakdown of what you can expect from the initial Alpha 0.01 release:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ba10f44762a2470293da8f3110f69067~mv2.png


Recap

To summarize the highlights of what you will be able to do during Alpha 0.01:


Play the game in English (the only available language for now!)
Create your character with basic customization (limited body types, hairstyles, and outfits)
Play through the Spring Season (the season will be looped)
Experience basic weather (Sunny, Rainy, Windy)
Decorate your house with basic furniture
Plant 12 Spring Crops
Enter the Blacksmith, Carpenter, Museum, Lab, & Charles’ House.
Upgrade your tools & seeds
Craft basic items
Increase NPCs’ hearts to 2 (unlock more dialogue)
Dive the North, South, West, and East maps @ 10m depth
Mine 25 levels in the Earth Gate 
Obtain Skills (Tier 1 only)
Do basic Quests
Donate basic items to the Museum

Things that didn’t make it for Alpha 0.01:

Ranching system (no chicken army)
Purchasing farm building
Heart event cutscenes
Some introduction cutscenes
Basic onboarding

In addition, here are ten things that you should do on Alpha 0.01!

Be mentally and physically prepared to start over your game, many many times.
Stumble upon surprising and unexpected bugs (like noodle hands!)
Report the bugs to us to be fixed
Waiting patiently while we do maintenance for the fixes
Sending us your feedback and suggestions for us to improve
Finding out our hidden Easter Egg!
Explore the beautiful island and meet its wonderful residents
Listening to some beautiful OST music while you’re playing
Share the experience with fellow Alpha players
Last but not least, and most importantly - have fun!


Thanks for reading,  

Stairway Team

Now, we can display our bugs and fish! It will have 2 different wings; 1 section will house bug catches and the other, exclusively, for the aquarium. In Coral Island, we have more than 60 fish to catch.


NPC Seasonal Outfits - UNLOCKED

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/294/362/de4eaa3756a6e2303ac90a2aa73a1cfc_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612768227&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=c446c9437097d23b5fa012b9b07bb8bd
Lily shown in Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/293/653/93d6195b50b6d0725429755009b3ba21_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612760762&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=41df9e45e0e91d7d77383c590dc02b82
Rafael shown in Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

In this update, you will see all islanders change outfits every season, totaling more than 170 outfit designs. We assign a color theme for every islander, play around with the design and color combination around it. This approach allows each NPC to be identifiable in-game throughout the year. At the same time, we are also making sure that each outfit design is still true to their character. This change in the outfit will bring the NPC and the overall game more alive! We can’t wait to share them with you.



Console and Switch port - UNLOCKED

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/309/554/3dc3a119008119d11d90e74257f39a40_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612874328&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=42ba6294fcf8acdbd2f55e2eb390f785


Q: When?
A: It depends on the platform holders, as they all have different policies. But our plan is to have Coral Island ported around 6 months after the early access release.


Q: Can I get a console/ Switch key instead of a Steam key?
A: Yes, absolutely! You will be able to choose between a console/Switch or Steam key.
 



Merfolk Underwater Village - UNLOCKED

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/484/262/e63fe44b2fea75e487a32b430f1afdb2_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1605863610&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=f5d6028222797f7a4afdd757a5a38156

This is your ticket to explore the underwater village. There are many merfolk villages around the world and this pass will allow you to traverse the one located by the coast of Coral Island. Decipher their language and develop relationships with them!



Kids Grow Up - UNLOCKED

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/322/378/22419fa8de5e0c1ab1eb2842596d5ef5_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1612950869&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=c47d3b99709e1e2bc17b91222e869404
Left to right. Current Zoe, Goat, Teenage Zoe

This feature will include additional stories and relationship development. There will be new schedules, dialogues, and many more! For the Player's children (you can have up to 2), there will be a variety of children's designs. The children will have their own personality and interest;  you can influence this as they grow up, or let them discover it on their own.  Worth noting that the children's characters/traits are not exactly tied to the spouse you marry.


Mod Support - UNLOCKED

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/338/183/043944021994545e69cd76cc911692ec_original.png?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1613055310&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=318fc93ec56728cb981e5966ac84cd59

In order for us to create modding tools that will best serve the community, we will start by first figuring out what parts of the game people want to mod the most. From there, a full-time developer will be assigned to continually expand moddable parts of the game.  We’re extremely excited to see what the modding community will create for Coral Island!   


What's next?

Multiplayer is next!!! Play with friends, spouse, whomever! We'll hire two additional full-time devs to implement co-op and up to 4 players online farm in Coral Island.

Kickstarter linked here.


Thank you for reading!

Stairway scavengers.

notes.title: Stretch goal: minigames UNLOCKED!
notes.content:
Minigames UNLOCKED

We just hit our first stretch goal of 125k! We’re so grateful for the amazing support. Now, let’s dive into the Minigames!

 Support us below:

Kickstarter linked here.


https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EteCw6JU0AYhgNx?format=jpg&name=900x900


Here are several of the minigames that we are adding for the full-release:


Available all year round, on the world map:

Mini-golf; Head to Pufferfish Corp. office and receive a token for 20c. Take a swing, get 3 strikes, and beat the high score! PS: Suki is the current Coral Island’s mini-golf champ.
High stake darts at the tavern, challenge yourself, and collect as many bullseyes as other Farmers. Do you dare?
An arcade game made exclusively by our in-house designer; it involves surviving an attack masterminded by giant forks. “Donut Survival by M.B.”
Dungeon cart-race; ride the questionably old cart inside the cavern. Get in and see how far it will take you. Watch for the turbulence ahead!
Home console; find the elusive home console and collect all of its game cartridges.
 

Featured in a festival:

Pet race!
Color-throw for a festival; let loose and test your aim. Grab colorful ammo and stain as many islanders as possible.
 

We are open to more ideas! Leave a comment to let us know what minigames might be cool to have. We will add at least 2 additional minigame ideas from the community.


So, what’s next?

Our next goal is at 175k for Bug Catching. You will be able to catch colorful bugs around the island and document them.


Thank you for reading!

Stairway folks.

notes.title: Announcement Trailer & Dec 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the December 2020 development update!

Announcement Trailer

The moment is finally here. Coral Island's announcement trailer is now live! Click on the following link to check it out:

[previewyoutube=JAMq-0or9pE;full][/previewyoutube]

Everyone in the studio is excited to hear what you think. You can let us know by joining our Discord server!

Kickstarter Pre-Launch Page

Our Kickstarter pre-launch page is also live. Click the Notify Me On Launch and you'll be the first to know when the campaign officially launches. Click on the following image to follow our project: 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_443ebb47b30840e78bec5d418d339cae~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_245,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_443ebb47b30840e78bec5d418d339cae~mv2.webp

We'll have exciting stretch goals and exclusive perks, including mythical pets and even access to the private Coral Island pre-alpha, and much more.

Character Reveals

Folks, this batch is our last character reveal. That said, there are still many unrevealed NPC! We want to keep them a mystery to give you something to look forward to, for when you arrive in Coral Island. Look around and meet them in person!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_6cf956975a0045a5a412090ec18ab452~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_6cf956975a0045a5a412090ec18ab452~mv2.webp
Meet Kira, Jack, Zarah (left to right)!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_4e71afb3be714411aca148922de398a7~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_4e71afb3be714411aca148922de398a7~mv2.webp
Kira. As a retired huntress with an adult son, everything in Kira’s life, right now, is basically self-sustainable. She spends her day keeping watch of the forest from the comfort of her cabin. Kira also enjoys doing yoga and playing the flute. Though retired, she still wears her combat boots, just in case...

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_1a09dda77d7e40b2ab0168fdaf97d376~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_1a09dda77d7e40b2ab0168fdaf97d376~mv2.webp
Jack. He, his wife, Kira, and their son, Kenny live in a humble cabin in the forest. Jack works as the island’s rancher. Aside from taking care of animals, Jack spends his day managing the shop’s supplies, making sure that they have enough to sell. On some days that they don't, the ranch is closed early. His hobbies include watching cooking shows and “experimenting” in the kitchen.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_96a35127a8f84176970b13f451c86880~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_96a35127a8f84176970b13f451c86880~mv2.webp
Zarah. An eligible bachelorette who is an adventurer at heart. Zarah lives on a boat. She enjoys going around the island and finding treasures; be it gems, old artifacts, or a buried history. Zarah was born and raised on the other side of Coral Island. When her boat is not docked at its usual place, she is presumed to visit her family. But what really is going on in her life, nobody really knows. She can be a bit mysterious at times. Allergic to cats.

The Lineup So Far
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_1636bb8351164a78a2e10e4a96a6581c~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_314,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_1636bb8351164a78a2e10e4a96a6581c~mv2.webp


Our Very Own Discord Server Emoji's

Last but not least, we're releasing the first batch of official Coral Island emoji's on our Discord server. What do you think?

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_977b2629a5ec40bb898dbb4051356dd8~mv2.gif

One can never have too many emoji's at their disposal... which means we want to involve you, our community, in deciding what emoji's we should make next. Head on over to Discord and cast your vote!

What's Next

Next month is a special one, folks! The Kickstarter campaign for Coral Island is launching on February 1, 2021. We will post campaign updates and fun insights into game development throughout the month through blog posts and tweets. As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: November 2020 mini Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the November 2020 development update!

Character Reveals
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_b3274daff15b480ebf9032596b36467c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_b3274daff15b480ebf9032596b36467c~mv2.webp
Meet Bree, Jim, Randy, Emily, Luke (left to right)!

The Lineup So Far
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_8f88f266d7764293bf6821521698bf2d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_393,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_8f88f266d7764293bf6821521698bf2d~mv2.webp

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_9d484812c777463a8220bdf486ebdcab~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_9d484812c777463a8220bdf486ebdcab~mv2.webp
Bree. This model-turned-housewife spends her days doing quality control for her vineyard. She is also an excellent homemaker who loves cooking gourmet meals and throwing parties. With a little bit of light detective work, Bree should be in her late 40s, though she's never directly confirmed this. To this day, it remains a mystery.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_99c88df60bcf4b999de260034149b918~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_99c88df60bcf4b999de260034149b918~mv2.webp
Jim.As a retired fisherman, he used to supply fish and seafood to local establishments. His son Theo inherited his boat and now fishes, something Jim is indifferent towards. With plenty of time on his hand, he spends the day making killer smoke salmon and helps run the Beach Shack.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_d2e90763f51849e2a941781d71356855~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_d2e90763f51849e2a941781d71356855~mv2.webp
Randy. As a full-time elementary teacher, Randy's remarkable ability to explain complex ideas in a very simple and easy-to-understand manner comes in handy. When he isn’t at school, he can be found at the Vineyard enjoying a glass of wine with his wife, Ling, or reading at the Library.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_1f88550e02a849c08d273e48d07ee11d~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_1f88550e02a849c08d273e48d07ee11d~mv2.webp
Emily. She runs the hair salon with Erika and lives on the second floor of the General Store, with her husband, Sam. The couple has been wanting to start a family since getting married, however have been unsuccessful.  Emily has a heart for vintage items and thinks mushrooms are disgusting.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_5bf3c06947e6445e898ce0ab1af2c05a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_5bf3c06947e6445e898ce0ab1af2c05a~mv2.webp
Luke.Coming from old-money, this bachelor lives with his parents and dog, Taco, in the manor behind the vineyard; a family business that he feels pressured to take over. Not a fan of the silver spoon, Luke runs Socket Electronics in his spare time in an attempt to create a name for himself, separate from his family legacy.


Farm Animals: Goat and Sheep

For Coral Island's Cow and Pig concept art, we went with a cute and kind-looking design, so we thought it would be fun to switch it up to a dignified and brisk look for Goat.

Goat. A barn-dwelling animal. They produce Goat Milk which can be turned into Goat Cheese for a premium charge. PS: extra goatee for that extra wise look.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_5f848c3217d64fe3a06d0e4b7c18a515~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_833,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_5f848c3217d64fe3a06d0e4b7c18a515~mv2.webp

Another barn-dweller, Sheep! Sheep can be sheared for its wool every several days. Keep in mind that a bad mood slows down wool growth. Also, we decided to go with four growth stages to emphasize its design.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_0e0cb5dfe3864bf38a8907da4ba43340~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_401,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_0e0cb5dfe3864bf38a8907da4ba43340~mv2.webp


Animation: Cow


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_9ad3463069f040c69978de999c2f805d~mv2.gif
This month, we want to share Coral Island's cow animation. As shown above, Cow is idling, presumably grazing grass outdoor on a sunny day! Don't worry about leaving your farm animals outside. To retire at the end of the day, cows will walk themselves back into the barn. So, relax and go about your business!


Summer Main Theme Music

https://soundcloud.com/user-527150285/summer/s-0TzMhIP9zsW


What's Next
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_86e2dd0176b9400cb8733091ebc1777a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_86e2dd0176b9400cb8733091ebc1777a~mv2.webp

Next month, we will be revealing 3 more characters, some animal showcase, and music. It's also a month away from the announcement trailer! As always, your feedback is appreciated.


Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: October 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the October 2020 development update!

Character Reveals
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_234877da139e48f3b656e49b0a93216a~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_234877da139e48f3b656e49b0a93216a~mv2.webp
Meet Sam, Ben, Ling, Alice (left to right).

The Lineup So Far
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_92a2f9cddf9e4c43a5365add268e977d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_314,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_92a2f9cddf9e4c43a5365add268e977d~mv2.webp

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_7d248df934014bfaab2910eaf5979881~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_7d248df934014bfaab2910eaf5979881~mv2.webp
Sam. He owns the general store and lives on the second floor with his wife. Sam usually spends his day off relaxing at home, enjoying home-cooked meals, and working on puzzles. On the rare occasion that he goes out, he visits the Beach Shack to catch up with his friends over chess.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_56e08c5040654f63b10553840142c0a1~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_56e08c5040654f63b10553840142c0a1~mv2.webp
Benis a nomad who lives in a caravan stationed in the forest. If you knock on his window on the weekend, he might have some random things to sell -- be it items he finds scavenging around the island or things that he doesn’t want anymore. Ben spends his money attending the Fall music festivals and green tea.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_012b162c72bd43b4934599042da5b3e9~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_012b162c72bd43b4934599042da5b3e9~mv2.webp
Ling. She spends her day working as a marine biologist at Coral Island laboratory. During time off, she knits cold-weather accessories, beanies, scarves, etc. She has dedicated her life to study coral reefs, and how to make them more resistant to rising ocean temperatures.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_f751a6f3725d425194ea2c86322b3733~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_1047,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_f751a6f3725d425194ea2c86322b3733~mv2.webp
Alice. A bachelorette. Alongside her twin sister Suki, they own, run, and live by the beach in Coral Inn. Running a business is hard, and running it with your sister is harder. Alice spends her days working at the inn, and her free time hanging out with friends in town. Loves minced jackfruit pies.


Beach Environment Showcase

Coral Island has a white sand beach along its coastline. You'll come across various wildlife and scavenge for items that only appear here. Islanders go here to fish, and on the weekends, spend time with family playing volleyball.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_49e5b08f3e6c406487019e438ce558de~mv2.gif
Take a peek at Coral Island’s coastline... And a cute little crab!



Ranching

This month, we've decided to show off ranching! Showcased here are level 1 coops. Small and cozy, they occupy 7x4 tiles. Before farm buildings are ready for use, they go through a construction phase.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f2bc32b67c2947ddbe7ddb7e7600c55d~mv2.gif
To keep ranch animals happy, you have to feed them every day. If you forget to feed animals, it affects their mood. An upset Chicken won't produce any eggs. No fodder, no egg!


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_c29c51d062424792ac07c2e4b718a54a~mv2.gif
PS: The coop interior is a work in progress. Also us before and after coffee.

Ranch animals have an indicator to let you know whether they can be petted, sheared, or milked. The Heart emote will disappear once a Ranch Animal is petted. 

Imagine having 5 cows and 10 chickens out in the field and not being able to keep track of which ones you've already petted? We think this might help.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3b86d5aa4a28437baed4cba878a9ad7b~mv2.gif

Ranching in action!

[previewyoutube=KkOwrcVKfGs;full][/previewyoutube]

Farm Animal: Cow

We’ve shared Pig and Chicken back in April (shown animated in July) and now, it’s time to reveal a chonkier, barn-dwelling animal, Cow.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f8a737e83511484298edd501e4aa0abc~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_f8a737e83511484298edd501e4aa0abc~mv2.webp
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d78b0cd491024f738ed6ce6ffc34e040~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d78b0cd491024f738ed6ce6ffc34e040~mv2.webp
Brown Cow vs. Regular Cow

Coral Island's Cow comes with four different horn designs. The design will be randomly selected when you purchase Cow from the Ranch. We think the diverse horn will give our Cow more identity.


When you welcome an adult cow onto your farm, they will come with one of four horn designs. We hope these horns will give your cows more identity, and make them more personable.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_09ead891f4254130bbfbf498dfcfb700~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_09ead891f4254130bbfbf498dfcfb700~mv2.webp

Once Cow is an adult, it can get pregnant and give birth to Baby Cow. During the pregnancy, Cow will stop producing milk. Keep in mind that Baby Cow can not produce milk until they mature. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9aa1ce2ffe894e2d9109fd0cf36c2451~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_375,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_9aa1ce2ffe894e2d9109fd0cf36c2451~mv2.webp

NPC Activity Animation

In addition to having different personalities, each islander in Coral Island also has their own hobbies and professions. Shown below is Theo, a daytime fisherman and an amateur entertainer by night. A look at how Theo spends his weekends, making a quick buck performing live at the Tavern.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_da3391550b0d47cc899a4b53adcca575~mv2.gif

Bug of The Month

Theo makes it to the bug of the month! Is it a bug or mad guitar skills? Twitter seems to think the latter, but we will let you decide on that.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_75c0174bff9149e78ceafd5f8650d32b~mv2.gif


What's Next
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/74a294_ad179c272a4a478dbbfe2600a60c8dd7~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_416,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/74a294_ad179c272a4a478dbbfe2600a60c8dd7~mv2.webp

Over the next 2 months, we are going to have less content to share on the blog. The reason being that the team needs to focus on delivering the announcement trailer, planned for January 2021. 

Instead, we will be doing mini updates with character reveals, music, animations and animals. The Diving blog post has been moved to the end of January 2021, to coincide with the trailer release. This means any update until then won't include game features. As always, your feedback is appreciated.


Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: September 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the September 2020 development update!

Character Reveals
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_32f2cd5aacf143c5b88274d58c6c86f4~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_32f2cd5aacf143c5b88274d58c6c86f4~mv2.webp
Meet Nina, Kenny, Pablo, Betty, Suki (left to right).

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_cdfd20536c834df3bb90557e6dfed525~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_393,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_cdfd20536c834df3bb90557e6dfed525~mv2.webp
The Lineup So Far - We are officially over halfway through our character reveals!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d56f1d778a5644b1b5091246009a991f~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d56f1d778a5644b1b5091246009a991f~mv2.webp
Nina. This bachelorette technically doesn't live in Coral Island anymore, but still visits her vacation home at the beach, from time to time. Aside from wild rumors around town, she's never talked about her abrupt departure, so it remains a mystery until now. A close friend with Suki.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_167a65d20cf7489e92037c1346182160~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_167a65d20cf7489e92037c1346182160~mv2.webp
Kenny, a part-time rancher, and full-time bachelor. He grew up in Coral Island and has fostered close relationships with other islanders-- be it people, animals, trees, spirits from the beyond-- all of them. Besides making friends, he loves having lunch outdoors, playing the flute, and cold kombucha

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8f568c1850c84e96ae56f701af6e6250~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_8f568c1850c84e96ae56f701af6e6250~mv2.webp
Pablo: He and his brother, Rafael, are both blacksmith and bachelors. When Pablo isn’t smelting ores, he can be found around town, lending hands to the townfolks, cleaning up the graveyard, or tossing anecdotes at the Tavern. Hates beaches—Dislikes sands in his shoes.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d8234ab061944029b33a2bdada3a9001~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_d8234ab061944029b33a2bdada3a9001~mv2.webp
Betty. Back in the day, Betty used to run the Tavern with her late husband, Frank Sr.. Now, she spends her retirement days going around town re-filling bird feeders, educating kids about coral reefs, and baking patisseries.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8002bb84cf9d4287b19e809814d7cfd3~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_1308,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_8002bb84cf9d4287b19e809814d7cfd3~mv2.webp
Suki is recently divorced and, according to her nightstand, currently “finding love from within,” and learning “how to expand love.” Focusing on herself, she drowns herself in work, exercise, and building a healthy co-parenting relationship with her ex.

Tile Menu Animations

Very excited to show more of the title menu. We've added several more animations. You can also check out styling for the options, new game and load game sections.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_d667060076124c4ba9b3ec6335a52b21~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0fd31c2b501645bda4e499d6064fd2e9~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_32ff5d5aeb554939b17f54a90caa7111~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_5732baba68d347bf8b1dffafb83eb275~mv2.gif

Interior Decoration System WIP

We've been hard at work implementing the logic of the interior decor system. It is now fully functional! Next is designing the UI, paying attention to both style and function. We'll be asking the community for feedback in Discord this coming month.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_66cb9784bd584ffc9179b046f560fbb5~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ae510f2c71e84a788b89f0958a9422b2~mv2.gif

NPC Activity Animation

Coral Island features a large cast of NPC's. Several of the islanders have unique professions and or responsibilities in town. We're implementing a wide range of animations that certain NPC's will play. The goal is to breathe life into these characters.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_f483f4ecb11f42c491df7d154116e3dd~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_3f527952a74640958d0fde293ae8dc16~mv2.gif

Spring Main Theme Music

We feel that music can help us to transport you to the shores of Coral Island. Today we are pleased to reveal the main theme song for Spring. Please let us know your thoughts!

Spring Main Theme Music Link

Town Center Building & House

A lot of work continues to be done in populating the game world. Featured this month is the town center, where both the museum, library and communal area reside. Somewhere in town, check out the house belonging to Lily, Theo and [redacted].
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_9b7a02b8d0c343edb95cc3a82b12f7f5~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_9b7a02b8d0c343edb95cc3a82b12f7f5~mv2.webp
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_fc43f266766f460aacc68ef9b6693b55~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_fc43f266766f460aacc68ef9b6693b55~mv2.webp


What's Next
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ea1b710196184c30bb772dddf5e00f02~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/491ae5_ea1b710196184c30bb772dddf5e00f02~mv2.webp

For October, we are not yet sure if we will reveal diving or ranching, but it will be one of those! You can also expect to see more character reveals and other areas in game. As always, your feedback is appreciated.


Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: August 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to the August 2020 development update!

Character Reveals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/a347a1d99ad6611a9ae4c57a4eb4c7437a23a5a0.png
Meet Leah, Rafael, Frank and Erika (left to right)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/689c226dffc74630c74f98693a895df2f83ddaa7.png
Leah lives her bachelorette life with her father and stepmom in an old massive house that the locals call “The Mansion.” She is a self-hired, yoga instructor at the community center and takes her online presence seriously. She spends her day wandering around the island with a camera on hand. Dislikes mushrooms and eggs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b1fecc711755054791685977f10e5e32b6b9dbcd.png
Rafael, along with his older brother, Pablo, who is also an eligible bachelor, run a local blacksmith shop. As a reserved fellow, Rafael is rarely seen out at town, but on rare days that he does, he can be found at Socket Electronics or Coral Inn, visiting his cousins and niece, Valentina.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/54758b687c1d943e75c20cede198ba067f00133a.png
Frank: He and his brother, Noah, run the tavern at the town center. Though he doesn’t live there anymore, Frank spends most of his time at the tavern, trying out new recipes. Frank is married to his high-school sweetheart, Erika, and the couple live with their 2 cats, Peanut and Butter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/cd2e6f614fd1d4d7e529c2d7dc0acabd41c01935.png
Erika: When she isn’t working at the salon or volunteering at school, she can be found around town, lending her ears to those in need, free of charge. She is honest and would say things as is. Perhaps a good candidate to marry if she weren't already married to Frank. Loves all sorts of jam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b01ef8af968b5423cda0898a37b573d636e29350.png
The Lineup So Far - Almost halfway there, before surprises!

Coral Island Main Theme Song
We're excited to reveal Coral Island's main theme song. Hopefully this can give you a glimpse of the adventures that await you on the island!

[previewyoutube=Ah173naoSZg;full][/previewyoutube]
[also a look at the title screen for Coral Island's early access launch]

General Store Interior & Translucent Walls
This August, we also showcase some interior work and how we deal with walls when indoors. Our pipeline is finally clear, so we are kicking interior production into high gear. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0d46e1e0c5ee4fad86e780f2fff0b789~mv2.gif
[walls will disappear when you enter rooms]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/976fedc72a6797f72726f52812ef8904b9d43b16.png
[Eva works at the General Store, she bakes the best cookies]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/70b6f0a99b7de854b4db9285c652f5250b42d41e.png
[work in progress look at the general store interior, polish incoming!]

Shop UI
There are several shops in Coral Island, each selling something unique. We tried our best to create a shop UI that blends both style and function. Please let us know your thoughts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/6514a4cd91f934aa328838400d3af8669cb7876d.png
[this is our bug of the month, you can probably guess this characters name lol. Also a soon to be revealed character]

Mining Sneak Peak
What's a farming game without mining! Although the level and assets are still a work in progress, we've overcome the hardest part of mining -- building the system itself! We can't wait to show off more layouts when something more polished is here.

[previewyoutube=1-IAb5Gdwfo;full][/previewyoutube]
[a look at the general feel and vibe we are going for in the mines]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_8306a7adc3c740508b260eca87a25981~mv2.gif
[we've added several animations that play depending on your point of entry down the rope]

What's Next
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/b4525f34da2159f4f721c0ba673874f0b0562b9c.png
[your next batch of characters!]

For September we'll be taking a look at interior customization for players house! You can also expect to see more character reveals and some animation work. As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: July 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to July’s 2020 development update!

Character Reveals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/7f2291ce4dd775068073904f441a801162cb22c2.png
Meet Surya, Eva, Zoe, Anne and Paul (left to right). Here is a little bit about them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/045a9c88e525e60cb5c80ed1a105f4d343027485.png
Surya, an eligible marriage candidate, is a fresh marine biologist graduate who is currently doing a fellowship in Coral Island. Like you, he is also new to the island! Loves Lodeh dish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/70695a11071b40f5b2776ffcf48086812cef3341.png
Eva is a bachelorette. She is a happy-go-lucky baker who works at the general store. She enjoys talking to the islanders, be it local, new, visitors, everybody! And is good friends with a lot of them. According to the islanders, Eva is always a delight to talk to-- a positive ray of sunshine. A fan of red velvet cakes and cookies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/469728e91eb052fd9bad70abeb2e50bba5e4899e.png
Zoe is a wild-life enthusiast, just like her parents. Zoe goes to school on the weekdays and spends her weekend following her dad around. She enjoys a game of volleyball, bird watching, and winters. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/2f7eda1993f0ae91d269b0ad290ca065035341d2.png
Anne makes a living by filming wildlife documentaries around Coral island. On the weekend, she can be found at the beach, enjoying the weather and sharpening her volleyball skills. She likes carrots and hummus combo for snacks, and a cup of green tea to start the day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/74111ca435de71ff44a119b0be9ac1db9b0d87f7.png
Paul is a dad, husband and wildlife enthusiast. Along with his wife, Anne, the couple spends their days capturing wildlife footage around the island. He would leap out of his bed the second he is needed to save animals, without hesitation. Big heart, likes hummus.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/74baf27142e90b8bc97c2a435b2b612646c4636f.png
The Lineup So Far - Moving forward, we will add newly revealed NPC's to this lineup. We hope this makes it a little easier to keep track of everyone you’ll meet in Coral Island. Note: we’re not even halfway there, plenty more to unveil!


Fishing Showcase
Coral Island features a robust fishing system. You’ll be able to catch fish in rivers, lakes and in the ocean. As you clear the island of pollution, you’ll unlock more species to catch, and perhaps, cross lines with something legendary.

[previewyoutube=WIVaSa_V4mc;full][/previewyoutube]

Animal Animations
This July, we also showcase some of the animations your farm animals will play. We have a mix of idle and 'rare' animations for you to check out:

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_48dca2eacd57486bbdef06a243431c59~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_ab0e16901b484321b1e77cf3c971fd94~mv2.gif
https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_0b1bd60ccf5f422189b82cd93e46d012~mv2.gif


Conversation UI
We are really excited to showcase the conversation UI! Please don't mind the grammar, that will be fixed in the coming months ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=IWgL3WWw6CI;full][/previewyoutube]
There are a ton of personalities to meet, so we want to make sure they look their best! After some experimentation, we feel that showing ¾ of the NPC portrait looks right. Displaying up to 3 lines of dialogue per box also feels good to read. What do you think?

Rainy and Windy Days in Coral Island
It’s not always sunny in Coral Island -- today we showcase what a windy day looks like, and how the environment changes when it rains.

[previewyoutube=BpXwpiAF1Ec;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=KSp06dchtqA;full][/previewyoutube]

Somewhere in Town
Nestled in Starlet Town is a temple -- it is the only one of its kind that is fully intact. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/6473eaf607ae360c72ab92d740fbd9469ea03f4a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/72cdac571c6bbb93add07050f1aae224f9981b6f.png

Bug Of The Month
One does not simply fish in the river.

[previewyoutube=ki91MlZ0wok;full][/previewyoutube]

What's Coming Next Month
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/9865c581f85bd40499d9525a372633ebfa5010c7.png

[we swapped July and August character reveals]

Next month we'll be revealing Coral Island's main theme song! You can also expect to see more character reveals and a look at the interior of the general store. Last but not least, be on the lookout for mining as well!  As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team

notes.title: June 2020 Dev Update
notes.content:
Welcome to another monthly development update. Before we begin, happy Pride Month!

Coral Island Is Coming to Steam

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/82bb28d3d42fbdf8db0012dce58052fb951fa58a.png

We're incredibly excited to share that our Steam page has officially launched. Please follow and wishlist the game.

Your Next Batch of Characters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/cc8782214c29832a5934254d55aeeb985a36f8b9.png

Meet Theo, Macy, Dippa and Charles (left to right). Here is a little bit about them:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3f877bc3b8b7a2a56b6dad302db08b7c3c10e6e3.png

Theo is an eligible marriage character. On the weekends, he makes a quick buck performing live at the tavern. He doesn't have what people call a “decent voice,” but he does have “soul” when he performs. Apparently, according to him, that's what's important. Day job: a fisherman.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/be7487dad19a590d4df0f3966095a922f6737a1c.png

Macy is an eligible marriage character. She grew up in a neighboring island and now lives full time at the Inn. She makes a living by selling images to a visual media company, Pletty inc. She loves simple nights, taking pictures, playing video games and Stephen, her rescued lobster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/3e5f47c1a89958318c74f3fe08fed4f657d07eda.png

Dippa usually spends their day looking for inspiration and painting around the island. They do not like night-outs, and think that those days are behind them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/efc764748a9a0f3bf22b7451b7b5813b1f1c489f.png

Charles, a town doctor, uses his free time catching up with the islanders at the tavern and going around spitting out medical advice.  Has pollen allergy, dislikes flowers.

Default Player Model

Please join us in welcoming version 1.0 of the farmer you might play as. Later this year, we'll showcase the customization options that will be available for your farmer at launch. Let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/2d9a7dede4ac4a814043a307ac06b6ed04202a27.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/840d139aee9cb6ad838f451c45b4a2c572d34a3f.gif
[your farmer will play different idle animations depending on the in-game time of day]

UI Showcase

The first iteration of our UI has finally made it into the game... So we finally feel comfortable showing you all a glimpse of what to expect.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_902e9bf6a0be45a1adb02b0b82df6dd5~mv2.gif
[text temporarily appears above icons when cycling through the inventory]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/f093173be6e5cfec8f05daef56422bd162164b7d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/dcb9bf1c77893eb1b7ed0d0dde9c07a5a9a6f18a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/e62fd2a626f34d96b26fa456e18f0dc675af3ce3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/0e1aadccb9005c143923985e7e99f44dee982b23.png
[other screens to give you a glimpse of various UI elements]

Improved Character Movement Animations

The biggest complaint we received from the initial gameplay snippet was the lacking quality in movement animation. We've tried to improve this by adding locomotion, which blends animation together. Feedback appreciated!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_1d63bfe504054286bc839c45f8d0efbd~mv2.gif
[start and end jogging anims are blended onto the new improved base jogging anim]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_72b2afd08eb24e34b9347df22810816d~mv2.gif
[we've added sprinting into the game, and it comes with a cool stop animation]

Tree Chopping & Translucency

Being able to see behind a tree is really important in farming games. We've spent a lot of time developing our solution, which both feels good, and keep those FPS up.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_072712d4ab9a42dba0c5bd231264d3cf~mv2.gif
[there is no such thing as hide and seek with the trees on your farm]

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/491ae5_7141b6793d9f44ef8b7d78d26c44f93c~mv2.gif
[Best Lumberjack Ever]

Bug Of The Month

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/f3473a9017ba94d3853d8130c1acfe46351ddb0f.gif

MJ does a moonwalk.
Chicken: "hold my beer'

What's Coming Next Month

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098234/9865c581f85bd40499d9525a372633ebfa5010c7.png

Next month, stay tuned for more character reveals and a look at fishing in the game. We'll also be showcasing what both rain and windy days look like on Coral Island. As always, your feedback is appreciated.

Thanks for reading,  Stairway Team
